title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds a new set of RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to the docs site and examples repo. Motivation: provide opinionated starter templates for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) + agents with tool-calling so developers can bootstrap common workflows (customer support summarization, knowledge-base Q&A, and structured tool execution). Includes: 1) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md with high-level guidance and configuration examples for hosted/dedicated/private deployments, 2) examples/agents/rag-playbook with TypeScript and Python quickstarts demonstrating tool registration, function calling, and safe execution patterns, 3) examples/agents/tool-calling-examples showing 3 toy tools (kb_search, ticket_creator, snippet_summarizer) and tests, 4) docs site navigation and sidebar updates + redirects. The description below lists commits, changed areas, and the review thread. Checklists: - [x] Add documentation pages and quickstart content - [x] Add runnable examples for TS/Python - [x] Add CI smoke tests for examples - [x] Update docs site nav and run docsite build - [x] Address reviewer comments and accessibility fixes
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) initial add of RAG templates and TS/Python examples (examples/agents/*, docs/quickstarts/*) 2) fix: switch to Redwood client v0.18 in examples and add env var hints + README improvements 3) docs site tweaks: sidebar ordering, redirects, accessibility alt text on diagrams
files_changed: docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md, examples/agents/rag-playbook/README.md, examples/agents/rag-playbook/ts/quickstart.ts, examples/agents/rag-playbook/py/quickstart.py, examples/agents/tool-calling-examples/* (3 tools + tests), docs/site/sidebar.json, docs/site/pages/agents/index.md, docs/assets/diagrams/rag-flow.svg
